description: Suggest purchase articles, accounts, and VAT settings for a new invoice based on similar confirmed invoices from the same supplier. Reverse-charge suggestions retain the historical rate/asset class and select KMD row 6 (EU) or 7 (non-EU) by supplier VAT prefix, then country; unknown region needs review. Returned past-invoice VAT options reflect this suggestion, not a change to the saved invoice.
name: suggest_booking
title: Suggest Purchase Booking
